lessons_used: Predictions continued to underpredict gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
Home wait_info changes were helpful, winning 4 of 5 tests.
Sign-in hint changes were helpful, winning 4 of 8 tests.
Sign-in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
Choose_path copy, home redesign, adoption redesign, and adoption incentive changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types with only a single test.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Rendering Tip Activity Display
candidates.change: Adds a dynamic tip carousel display and rendering countdown timer to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home has a high median wait time of 201s and previous home wait_info changes won 4 out of 5 tests.

guard.reason: Adds tip carousel and rendering wait estimate without breaking rules.

candidates.score_note: Home loses few overall users (94.2% pass), but wait_info changes have strong win rate (4/5 tests).

candidates.title: Account Multi Pet Synchronization Hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear sign-in hint reassuring users that signing in will automatically sync and restore existing desktop pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after sign-in, and sign-in hints have a high historical win rate (4 of 8).

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically syncs and restores your existing desktop pets and companion data.

guard.reason: Adds sign-in hint within onboarding without violating pricing or dark patterns.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails; sign-in hints consistently perform well (+2.1% avg).

candidates.title: Adoption Pet Companion Trait Selection Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive companion personality trait selection sub-flow during the pet picking stage.
candidates.why: Adoption is a key bottleneck with only 66.0% conversion and 89s median time.

components.text: Select companion personality: Playful, Calm, or Energetic

guard.reason: Adds personality trait sub-flow selection during friend picking stage.

candidates.score_note: Adoption is the biggest bottleneck step (66% pass), but a full sub-flow incurs high implementation cost.

candidates.title: Home Desktop Pet Hatching Minigame Screen
candidates.change: Inserts an interactive egg hatching minigame screen while pet rendering processes in the background.
candidates.why: Home median wait time is 201s with long mean delays; interactive engagement during waiting keeps users from abandoning.

new_hatching_minigame.headline: Interact with your pet egg while it finishes hatching!

guard.reason: Inserts a new hatching minigame screen inside onboarding while preserving all mandatory steps.

candidates.score_note: New screens in home showed negative results (-2.0%) in previous tests and require high effort.

candidates.title: Sign-In Session Recovery Hint
candidates.change: Provides an explicit session recovery safety hint on sign-in to reassure users against app stalls and login failures.
candidates.why: Support received 2 emails about sign-in screen stalling or failing to load.

sign_in.hint: Fast session authentication guarantees instant desktop pet retrieval without stalling.

guard.reason: Adds valid sign-in copy hint within onboarding guidelines.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint fix supported by user emails and solid historical hint performance.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Rendering Live Status Checklist
candidates.change: Replaces static wait status with a live multi-stage rendering progress checklist.
candidates.why: Home wait_info improvements are strong historical winners (4 of 5 tests won).

wait_status.text: Generating pet model... Preparing desktop animations...

guard.reason: 'waiting.replace.wait_status[0]': a checklist cannot do the wait_status job (use ['animation', 'mascot', 'preview', 'progress', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel'])

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Finish Controls Overview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the finish screen into a split layout showcasing quick desktop pet controls, tray shortcuts, and hide options.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Click your pet or use the system tray menu to interact, open controls, or hide companion anytime.

home_welcome.text: Desktop Pet Control Basics & Shortcut Guide

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Celebration Showcase Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a stage layout featuring live pet previews and progress indicators.
candidates.why: Adoption stage experiences high drop-off (66.0% completion rate).

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.certificate' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'preview'] with an asset:certificate/ asset

candidates.title: Path Selection Companion Preview Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explanatory hint under path choices detailing how each path affects desktop pet interactions.
candidates.why: Path selection drops 20.3% of users; clearer expectations help users make faster decisions.

choose_path.hint: Your path selection determines your companion pet's daily desktop activities and behavior.

guard.reason: Adds informational path preview hint without altering rules or pricing.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path has moderate dropoff (20.3%); hints show steady positive results (+1.4%).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Rendering Companion Mascot Display
candidates.change: Adds an animated companion mascot and progress bar during background rendering on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Wait info enhancements have proven highly successful for reducing drop-off during long renders.

guard.reason: Adds progress bar and mascot component to waiting screen while retaining its job.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes are reliable winners (4 of 5 tests), though mascot graphics require mild dev work.
